reviews.title: Worst Airline
reviews.text: Do not fly on Jetstar if you can avoid it. They cancelled my flight with less than 24-hours notice, and rescheduled me to an early morning departure. I had to book a hotel, get a taxi to the airport, wake up at 3am and miss all of my holiday plans due to their cancellation. The reason given was a staffing issue at the originally scheduled time. I have to submit receipts for reimbursement within 10 days - for accommodations and food during the delay. But no credits or reimbursement for a missed day of holiday or non-refundable excursions. The staff at jetstar insulted my nationality when I asked for additional assistance. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.author: Neil C

reviews.title: Not worth it...
reviews.text: If you do not need to check in any luggage, on a tight budget, or care about in-flight entertainment, Jetstar Japan may be an option for you. I flew NRT-OKA R/T in June 2023. Going OKA-NRT we arrived at the gate 10 min prior to departure and the sign was off & no staff. We honestly thought we missed the flight but it was just delayed-no announcement. The RETURN- Smooth check in at Naha airport, friendly staff, flight on time, fantastic in flight cabin crew. THEN, the luggage I had checked in... WAS NOT at baggage claim! BUT, there were 2 pieces of unclaimed bags going around and around- Belonging to the same person... NO ONE is at baggage claim.. Finally, a wheelchair staff comes by, so I ask them for help. WELL, I must now go out of baggage claim, go upstairs, and try to find a helpful Jetstar staff. Okay. There are many Jetstar staff at the check in counter. Can they help in this situation. NO.. NOT at all.. Jetstar staff could not positively say my luggage arrived in NRT. What!? And , they insinuated that my standing by the check in counter was not good because it would take a long time. FOR REAL?! I have to force my contact info on them! Jetstar procedure is to "Kuroneko Yamato"(mail) to the destination that you designate. Unfortunately, I was continuing internationally. If Jetstar determined "someone accidentaly" took my bag, that person would be required to pay for postage. WTF!! Jetstar is a LCC. Postage will be $$ than airfare. I still have not been given a lost luggage claim #, no update from ground staff at NRT as they promised, or any online response. NOTHING! NOT. WORTH . IT.
reviews.author: ms c

reviews.title: Highly recommend.  You would never think that they are a budget airline.
reviews.text: I flew them internally from Tokyo to Osaka one way. Like most things in Japan, very efficient. Can't complain. Very good. Budget airlines in most countries are often a nightmare. This was like a normal airline. Better than BA! Flight departed on time and landed punctually. Efficient. Boarding was quick. Luggage came out fast in Osaka. Checking in online was easy as was the self-service bag drop at the airport. Staff were super friendly and helpful. Plane was clean. As it was a short flight, there were no complimentary refreshments but you could purchase snacks and drinks onboard (you can also pre-order in advance, just check the website). No charging sockets or in-flight entertainment as the flight was only one and a half hours. Seats were fine for short haul. You can pay for a seat or get one allocated for free. I just got one allocated which was a middle seat. It was a short flight and I didn't want to pay for it. I can't remember if my check in bag was included in the fare or if I paid extra. The fare was cheap anyway and a lot less than the JR. I have been to Japan before. If it is your first time, go on the JR for the experience and scenery. A few tips. If you are flying internally, Jetstar do not allow you to check your bag in until 2 hours before the flight so don't get to the airport too early. You are most likely to depart from Terminal 3 if using Narita. Not the most exciting. Past security there is nothing much so I suggest staying in the departure area after you have checked in as there are a few shops and a lot of eateries. Go through security as late as possible but give yourself enough time to get to your gate (small terminal). Past security there is just one shop. Wifi is good around the terminal.
reviews.author: Inlovewiththeworld

reviews.title:
Boarding confusion not related to language differences
At Jetstar flight JQ26 from Narita to Cairns
reviews.text: When arrived at gate 151 we were already late. There was no signage or monitors telling you that you were in the correct place. A japanese staff member was asked to confirm with showing of our boarding pass. And she just said no and shaking of head, so panick set in regarding potentially missing flight. Uniforms didnt appear to be the ususal Jetstar colours and didnt appear to be obviously Jetstar logo. Nelson Flight JQ26 1/6/23
reviews.author: Nelson Y

reviews.title: Do not fly Jetstar to/from Japan!
reviews.text: For no fault of their own (medical emergency) our flight from Tokyo had to do a U-turn and land again at Narita and being too late, the flight was cancelled. The problem is that the company had no contingency plan for such an occurrence. A hotel was organised (50 minutes away) and we were told to catch at taxi that would be reimbursed when we got home (32000 yens!!). BUT, given it was 1 am, there were NO taxis at the airport . We waited for hours , luckily for us, some Japanese rang taxis and we could get on with them and arrived at the hotel at 4 am. But some people didn't make it and stayed all night at the airport as taxis were reluctant to come- that is if you could speak Japanese to contact them. Jetstar didn't organise buses nor rang taxi companies to tell them to send cars to the airport. It looked to me that the poor 'Jetstar' staff were contract staff and were completely disorganised, that they were no manager of Jetstar in Japan to lead a response for this situation. Flight cancellations happen, why not be prepared for such situations? Appalling- all the people we talked to on the flight will never fly Jetstar again, including us. Also terminal 3 in Narita (for low cost airlines) is not the level of airport service you expect in Japan..
reviews.author: 2miaou2016

reviews.title: I was 2 minutes late. Literally  TWO minutes max till closing gate and the did not let me in
reviews.text: I was 2 minutes late. Literally TWO minutes max till closing gate and the did not let me in. Did not do or help with anything and then asked 75% from next day ticket for rebooking.Worst company ever. Do not use unless you hate your money. Because in the end it will cost you more than everyone else. As everyone said you pay for everything. There are no guaranties no food nothing in Jetstar service pay.
reviews.author: Online S

reviews.title: JetStar, the Star that NEVER SMILE
reviews.text: This is the first time I travelled to Narita by Jestar, previous travels were with Cebu Pacific (also a low cost airline). Comparing the 2, I would say that crew of Cebu Pacfic, from ground to flights are generally friendly and accomodating, while JetStar crew are blunt in so many ways. The flight crew are the worst, you'll never feel relax with them as they maintained stone face all through out the flight. Only time they gave a consolation to passengers is during deplaning when they give effortly feigned smile greeting you out.
reviews.author: Edison Gatioan

reviews.title: No Jetstar joy on this long haul flight.
reviews.text: Yes we know what to expect with a low cost carrier like Jetstar. Cramped seating and packed to capacity, delayed flights if it's not full, and of course you have to pay for Everything! So thankyou Alan Joyce for yet again, putting profit before people ! But the icing on the cake on our recent trip to Tokyo was the joyless choice of food and beverage options. Joyce's cost-cutting endeavours now extends to denying the long haul passenger the option of a decent meal, even if you have to pay for it. And it's marketed to the customer as a positive step towards a more environmentally sustainable airline ! You could buy among other things, a sausage roll and meat pie combo, a couple of sandwich options including a ham and cheese toastie or a styrofoam bowl of dried noodles with a flavour sachet ! And all were tasteless and overpriced and the very same menu as that provided on Jetstar domestic flights. Sydney to Tokyo is a 9 to 10 hour flight. Yes, we have all come to expect some level of discomfort in exchange for cheaper priced flights but Joyce has turned this exercise into 9 to 10 hours of punishing misery.
reviews.author: LFC

reviews.title: Jetstar sucks
reviews.text: Flight got cancelled cos of covid. Received voucher but got expired since no flight available. Then won't reissue now what a sucker
reviews.author: Angelique

reviews.title: Was not able to make flight due to forces outside of Jetstar control.
reviews.text: After excepting the fact that I would not make the flight due to my travel agency flying me into Hanede and out of Narita, I was given an option to pay a fee to change the flight long story short I didn't take the next flight and all I was asking to be returned was the fee to change the flight they will not refund me that money I know that I forfeit the flight fee but even the fee to change flights? I will be avoiding this airline in the future.
reviews.author: Samuel R

reviews.title: Worst service
reviews.text: I will not used this jet airlines because I got many problems when checkin and staff are not helpful.and same airlines but rule from Okinawa to narita is different.so I never used this airlines.I would like to request you all not to used this airlines.
reviews.author: Tamang

reviews.title: Don't fly with jetstar
reviews.text: The worst airline I have ever booked through they charged us $100 extra even though we had transferable tickets. And we paid extra for a heave bag and when we got to the check in counter the made use take stuff out of our bag to make it lighter. Then when we went to give the bag to the people we where told to they didn't know what to do with it and we had to find a manager. Then when we got the gate to leave there where no seats to sit in. What kind of airport doest have seats that's ridiculous. So by far the worst flying experience I have ever had. don't fly with JETSTAR they will screw you for every penny you have just take the train it is way better.
reviews.author: sebastian w

reviews.title: Late and disorganized
reviews.text: After waiting in a 50 minute check in/ baggage drop line, being forced to go through “jet star only customs” (three other gates wide open for other airlines), and waiting 30+ minutes past boarding time at the gate I am writing this to hopefully deter any other potential victims of this bumbling airline. Not worth the $20 saved. Thankfully we got to the airport hours early to deal with the chaos.
reviews.author: Hunter

reviews.title: BEWARE: WORST AIRLINE EVER!!!
reviews.text: BEWARE!!! THIS IS THE WORST AIRLINE EVER. I came from a 3rd world country, experienced 3rd world airlines, but this airline is the worst. They left almost all passengers’ baggage in Narita. We boarded the plane at 7:50pm (flight is at 7:35pm) We waited in the aircraft for another hour, everyone was asleep, saw the staff in front talking seems like theres a problem. Then the gates closed flied out at 8:50pm. When we arrived in Manila, there’s a baggage falling out on the baggage counter machine. after 20 bags fell, the staff shouted “There’s no more bags” in TAGALOG. mind you there are foreigners here. They asked us to go to the baggage assistance counter. All this time Jetstar crew did not inform us while we were at the plane. It took us 3-4 hours in the line at the baggage counter. THEY CANNOT GIVE US A DEFINITE ANSWER ON WHAT HAPPENED AND WHEN WILL WE GET OUR BAGS. Now it’s been 3 days of calling, emailing and messaging jetstar, they just say to wait for the case manager. UP TO NOW. NO ONE IS CONTACTING US EVEN AFTER MULTIPLE EMAILS AND CALL FF UPS. They said there’s no compensation for this. Its been almost 4 days now, and still they do not answer and no info on when can we get the bags or is it still alive is it not lost??? I WANNA CRY SO BAD, ALL MY BELONGINGS, GIFT FROM MY FAMILY MY PARENTS WHO I WILL NOT SEE AGAIN FOR A LONG TIME, ALL THE SENTIMENTAL ITEMS IN THAT BAG. NO ASSURANCE ON WHERE IT IS. THIS IS THE WORST AIRLINE. THIS HAPPENED TO A LOT OF OTHER FLIGHTS, EVEN WORST THAN WHAT IVE EXPERIENCED. BEWARE GUYS BEWARE!!! They just want your money! If you dont want to experience what most of us passengers did. DO NOT BOOK THIS AIRLINE!!! Mind u they have a japanese staff which are supposed to be very nice, helpful and above beyond service. for the first time, these are the worst Japanese staff i’ve experienced. They are not friendly, rude and they do not care at all. Especially to Filipinos, but you can see that they are nice to Westerns and Japanese. I swear, i cannot believe what I saw. Just do not book this airline. It will cost you your sanity
reviews.author: Meg T.

reviews.title: Late and later,  but they sure work hard as they can to make it right
reviews.text: Flying outta Sapporo, flight was delayed due to “aircraft rotation, which is fine. Then the rescheduled flight we delayed again. Okay… Then the aircraft was late again but they refused to admit it would be delayed again. I sat in worry as the boarding time came and passed. Representation was absent. When they showed up right at the delayed departure time, nobody was boarded, and I asked what time they really thought we would be landing. They literally ran off without answering to do attend to another matter. They refused to officially announce it was delayed yet again. Just give me a reasonable timeframe so I can let my hotel know not to close the check in on me (as this one closed at 10pm and at this point I was really pushing my luck) In the end they were super apologetic to the entire plane, and let us know they would make right anyones travel arrangements that had been seriously affected. I had to rush like the wind, but I just made my hotel check in.
reviews.author: Natural E

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised business class
reviews.text: We were skeptical about Jetstar as we only read and hear poor reviews. So when our daughter suggested it we were very wary. What a nice surprise! The staff were great, food excellent and seats very comfortable. TV also great. Well done Jetstar
reviews.author: TJS

reviews.title: Avoid jetstar if you can!
reviews.text: if you are flying to japan and have a connecting flight to your final destination in japan (for me, okinawa), it is better to choose the japanese language choice than the english when you make a phonecall to jetstar 05031638538). the english speakers do NOT know anything about connecting flights in japan and give you wrong information...super frustrating. if you fly air canda and connecting flight with jetstar japan, you should have same 1 pce checked bag @23kg for free but you'll be limited to only 7 kg total carryon (max 2 items) when on air canada there is no weight restriction for carry on as long as you can store it in the overhead bin yourself. THEY ARE EXTREMELY STRICT ON 7 KG AND WILL MAKE YOU PAY IF OVER THE LIMIT. when you arrive at narita airport, you must pick up your bags, change terminals (from 1 to 3) and check in for your connecting flight and check in your bags. if you fly japan airlines connecting flight with jetstar japan, you should have same 2 pieces checked bags @23kg each for free. carryon is 10kg on JAL but only 7kg on jetstar. BE CAREFUL YOU DON'T EXCEED 7kg. when returning home (to vancouver) on JAL via jetstar, i was told by jetstar you can check your bags straight thru to vancouver. you will have to move from terminal 3 to terminal 2 and check into JAL for your intl segment. when returning on Air Canada via jetstar, your bags will NOT be checked thru to vancouver. you'll need to pick up your bags at terminal 3, move to terminal 1, check into air canada and check in your bags. if you are even a little over 23kg, you'll have to pay. it helps to have a portable luggage scale! hope this info helps someone out there. i was told by air canada that luggage rules would be the same across all flights (they were not). i was also told i'd be able to check my bags from okinawa straight to vancouver as there was an interline agreement. (that was not the case) also, do not buy a hot drink before boarding jetstar. my daughter ran back with a tea from starbucks for me. i was asked if my tea was hot or cold. i had to dump it. maybe put it in a flask? but make sure you don't exceed the weight limit!
reviews.author: teamtravel4

reviews.title: It's not worth your money at all
reviews.text: Terrible airline. Our flight was informed to be cancelled a few hours before departure. We tried talking to them to see what options we had available. One lady from the staff was nice enough to listen to us, but the manager was incredibly rude. This was on October 22, 2022, around 5:00 PM. I don't know her name, but I genuinely believe that she shouldn't keep working "helping customers" because she just made me hate this airline even more. I won't ever go with this airline again nor recommend to anyone. Terrible, not worth at all.
reviews.author: Isaac Correa

reviews.title: Appalling
reviews.text: Jetstar are not just a low cost airline they are also a low service airline. Connecting from a Emirates flight to JS12, Tokyo Narita to Sydney via the Gold Coast, we were transferred to terminal 3 at about 6pm with no information, no boarding pass, no Jetstar staff and none of the terminal services open, nothing. After about 45min a single Jetstar staff member arrived and a que for boarding passes formed. After 2 and a half hours and just 10min before the scheduled departure time they still had not processed the 80 odd passengers waiting for for boarding passes. Then the flight was 1 hour and 20 minutes late departing Narita. We had paid extra for meals to be included. "Meal" was a child's size portion of disgusting butter chicken and rice. No drinks were included, they cost extra. 7 hours later we were given a slice of dry banana bread and a cup of weak tea for breakfast. Arrival into Sydney was about 2 hours late then there was a half hour wait for our bags. My advice is give Jetstar a miss. I know I will.
reviews.author: Gary H

reviews.title: Don’t worth it
reviews.text: The service is very poor. They try to rip you off for everything. And they won’t let you use any clothes to cover the legs saying that it’s against their rules . Rude service and they don’t let you change your seats (I wanted to change the seat with my uncle to give him more leg space) but they rudely refused.
reviews.author: Khamida21

reviews.title: Please avoid for your own sanity
reviews.text: Borderline SCAM. They have a hidden weight fee where if you are even 1 kg over 7 kg, they charge an extra 4000 JPY to access the next tier at 14 kg for carry-ons. Flight was also delayed by half an hour for no particular reason (it was sunny outside.) The attendants at the gate were also not helpful and had a bad attitude. I'd like to ask the CEOs (both Japan and Australian bases) how they feel about running a business model that feels no shame in squeezing the common Joe for every last penny in their pockets. Never flying with Jetstar again, and telling all my close contacts as well. DO NOT choose this airline; there are much better services here in Japan for just a couple more yen. 本当に国内の最悪な体験がありまして、これからの使用を避けます。こう言う詐欺会社をマジ改善して欲しいです。恥を知れ！
reviews.author: Bruce Z

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: Good value, no frills airline. We had not issues considering we flew in the middle of the pandemic just after the border to Tas opened. I was suprised how smoothly it went! thank you jetstar!
reviews.author: Lyne C

reviews.title: Don't do it
reviews.text: If you are used to flying Allegiant or Frontier, cut rate US carriers, Jet Star is worse. Manage your expectations: 1. Baggage fees are equal to or greater than ticket price. 2. No code share partners. Claim your bags after your jetstar flight, then recheck them to final destination. 3. No gates. Get on a bus, ride it to a remote spot on the tarmac where the plane is parked. Raining? Too bad. 4. Your reservation number is nearly impossible to find online and an advance seat assignment? Forget it. But it all comes with some spicy Aussie attitude. Worth it? Not. Next time, I book a real airline.
reviews.author: Jimmy S

reviews.title: Last minute maintenance
reviews.text: They were late for boarding, then told all their customer that there is a maintenence so everyone had to change their flight..
reviews.author: Datricky H

reviews.title: Excellent experience and not for the first time
reviews.text: I had another good flight with Jetstar from Tokyo to Fukuoka. It’s nice to see competent Japanese flight-crew in Japan keeping quality at Japanese standards. Tomoko, Ari and Kaheshi, if I remember their names well, were excellent hosts on this flight, very polite and professional. I had extra leg room and a choice of 3 items with coffee on the menu. The chocolate muffin is the better deal because it’s satiatious compared to the waffle and the pound cake, which are too small and too light, although very tasty. The flight was a little bumpy but that’s not surprising given the size of the airplane. Handbags are restricted to 7 kg and to a certain volume, so that everyone’s luggage fits above their seats without improvisations. I’m really happy that they’re very strict about this because it allowed me to find easily a place for my handbag above my seat without all the fuss and the headaches I get on other flights. Many people give 1 a star review and complain about this issue. I’m sure they are the same type of people who are usually crowding the gate on other flights in order to be first on the plane and fill-up all available space with their handbags, leaving no room for my computer bag. Unlike them, I was really happy with the quality of services. I wish we could still have such good services in Europe.
reviews.author: Razvan Ion P

reviews.title: Be careful. Super strict about weight! Skip them.
reviews.text: Super strict about the weight allowance! They really mean it when they say 7 kg in total for all items. Basically, if you travel with your computer, charger, and a small suitcase with a couple of changes, you probably already over 7kg. They have scales at the boarding gate and they won’t let you in without a sticker. They won’t close an eye making you pay almost the same price you paid for the ticket! Cheap way to fool people and make a business out of it. Unhappy with the service. Next time I’ll Just pay a bit more in advance to fly with a better company.
reviews.author: Simone M

reviews.title: Terrible Airline Experience
reviews.text: Though Jetstar Japan is billed as the leading budget airline in Japan, I have trouble believing this claim given absolutely abhorrent service and worst practices demonstrated by the airline personnel. Upon scan checking for my flight out of Narita recently, the gate agent was decidedly slow and unhelpful. I was then subjected to additional security checks though there were very few other passengers (noticing that I was the only non-Japanese in line). Upon arrival at the departure gate, I was informed that the gate doors had closed early as all the other passengers had boarded and could not be opened again — even though the plane remained secured to the gate for sometime thereafter. I was then escorted out of the departure gate area as I was told my ticket was no longer valid, and I would need to pay an additional fee in order to purchase another ticket to take the next available flight to my destination, resulting in five hour delay while waiting on the hard seats of the spartan Jetstar terminal. The indifference and poor service level shown by this airline was jarring. I would not recommend flying this carrier unless it is the only one flying into the destination that one needs to get to only accessible by air and you don’t mind unpredictably poor service, additional surcharges, and bumped flights. Review Rating: Jetstar = 1 star
reviews.author: aizuchi

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Be ready to have your patience tested as Jetstar will try every tricks in the book to extort you money. From weighting your handbag with your carry on (that no other companies do) to being obstinate about making you adhere to their arbitrary rules. We were two, with luggages below the limits one luggage at 6, one at 8, below the limits right? Not for Jetstar, if the number on the scale are not right they will try to ask for more money.
reviews.author: Jetstaristheworst

reviews.title: extra payment over grams
reviews.text: Was expecting this to be the cheapest flight i ever boarded. To my deception, when i was checking in on the reception desk, the staff greeted me with sarcasm and bad comments. They started the conversation with a smile, and after checking the weight of my luggage which was at 7.6kbg they told me you cannot take a backpack, and a lugagge on the airplane. Both of them weighed at 9.1kg and they eventually made me pay a fee of 35$ For having two extra kgs. When i was explaining to the staff that it said on their website that the limit was 10kg for both the backpack and the suitcase they laughed at me and told me “ you must have been checking another airline, please go to the counter and pay the extra luggage ! “ Never taking an airline with poor customer service and deceitful prices !!!!
reviews.author: Julles

reviews.title: Be aware of the cancellation policy when you book
reviews.text: Due to Corona virus the flight I had booked was cancelled. We all accept that in these times it is going to be difficult, but the accommodation has given a full refund while Jetstar provides a voucher which can be used for future flights. The voucher must be used within 6 months for travel within 12 months. Who can say if they will want to (or be able to) travel in 6 months time. Meanwhile I have the concern that Jetstar like most airlines is in serious financial difficulty and I am an unsecured creditor with $2100 owed to me. On the positive side (and why I have not given a lower rating) their communication online has been clear and concise and I have been able to request the voucher without difficulty online. Difficult times test the preparedness of businesses and I guess when we use budget services the cost saving comes at a price.
reviews.author: terry M

reviews.title: Return to Okinawa
reviews.text: Great flight. Very attentive service from Stewards. Good leg room. Good value for a low budget airline
reviews.author: Glenda2020

reviews.title: Absolutely fine for a low cost flight
reviews.text: I fly Jetstar regularly as it flies direct out of my home town. Never had a serious problem with them. They are low-cost so I don't expect much but they have always been helpful and polite, on time. What more do you need?
reviews.author: Cathy L

reviews.title: Dreadful Customer Service - Never Fly with Them
reviews.text: We were looking forward to our trip to Japan - due tomorrow. However, as we are elderly and have existing health conditions, we decided reluctantly to cancel our trip. All airlines, hotels and service providers have refunded charges - even our travel insurer. Not Jetstar however. They insist on sending us vouchers that have to used in Japan within 6 months. These are of no value to us, as there is no prospect of returning within that period. They not only refuse to even consider a refund, unlike everyone else, but they also refuse to upscale our complain=t to a higher level. NEVER FLY WITH THIS AIRLINE. THEY DON'T TREAT PASSENGERS AS HUMAN BEINGS.
reviews.author: AntrobusLondon

reviews.title: The worst airline ever
reviews.text: The worst experience you’ll ever have. It might be cheap and you get exactly what you pay for. And even worse. And it will end up costing you the same price as the other air carrier or even more. So please consider this seriously or you go experience the worst as I did.
reviews.author: Pinocotta

reviews.title: Worst airline ever! Incompetent staff, zero regard for those with allergies!
reviews.text: I sent the below to a jet star live chat agent. His response was “I will pass on your comments to management but can’t ensure anyone will contact you regarding your concerns” On Friday 7th February, myself and my partner flew with Jet Star from Carins to Bali. A week prior to checking in, we called to inform Jetstar my partner has a severe nut allergy. We was instructed to visit a doctor to get medical forms signed which confirmed he had a nut allergy. When we arrived at check in, the lady had no idea about my partners nut allergy, the information had not been relayed despite providing the flight number and all necessary information for it to be noted. The lady at check in did not have any idea what the medical form was and said she had never seen one before, which obviously did not fill us with confidence and also suggests there is major training needed across your staff. To add to our frustration of the lack of communication amongst staff, the minute we stepped on the flight, the air hostesses also had no idea about my partners nut allergy! The lady who checked us in failed to pass on the life threatening information to where it mattered the most, to the air hostesses on the flight. At this point, we had zero faith in the staff, so when our meal arrived, we checked the ingredients which is extremely lucky as my partner was then served a meal which clearly stated on the label “contains nuts” and “contains almonds”. When we informed the air hostess of this life threatening error, she said “the staff at the back of the flight didn’t know about the allergy” and was not apologetic about the extremely concerning error. Surely if one member of staff is informed of such a severe allergy, they have a duty to communicate that information to all other staff on board? How hard is it to radio through or walk to the back of the plane to inform all staff? An action which could potentially save someone’s life. Myself and my partner then went without a meal for the flight. The staff also served peanuts on the flight to a passenger who was sat directly infront of my partner, my partner then had to sit with his clothing over his face before standing at the front of the plane as he didn’t feel comfortable sitting in the seat that he had paid for. I am confident that for the sake of someone’s life, Jetstar could have refused to serve nuts to all passengers on a 4 hour flight, it is not depriving anyone of a human right. I am extremely concerned at how competent Jetstar staff are at their jobs. The lack of communication amongst staff was appalling, we did everything required on our end, spending time and money to get “medical forms” signed by doctors, which went ignored and staff had zero knowledge of. As customers, we should not have to inform each individual member of staff of the allergy. Once we rang Jetstar, we should have been able to trust that the information would be relayed appropriately where necessary. When checking in, the lady should have been aware of the forms she would be receiving that day and well across how that information would be passed on to air hostesses. It is extremely disappointing how little regard your staff had for my partner. To serve a customer with a life threatening nut allergy a meal containing almonds, despite all of the above is absolutely appalling and reflects how little regard/respect Jetstar has for its paying customers. Had my partner trusted Jetstar, as he should have been able too, he would be dead and there would have been a manslaughter charge on your hands. I suggest a major reform in Jetstar staff training is needed imminently, alongside huge improvements in the customer care you provide, a principle your airline seems to rely heavily upon. Overall, terrible customer service and will be ensuring that I advise all those on allergy forums to not use your airline.
reviews.author: kljg1

reviews.title: don't bother paying for business seating
reviews.text: Paid for the extra space and comfort but was disappointed. Have travelled business with other airlines and have to say that Jetstar 787's business seating was a let down. Old and no more comfortable that an economy seat. My advice, don't waste your hard earned cash.
reviews.author: maulihua

reviews.title: No Longer Unbearable.
reviews.text: I fly Qantas. I don’t like to fly Jetstar, I only do so out of necessity. There have been too many occasions in the past where my flight had been delayed and I have been stuck in that awful temporary Melbourne airport lounge for hours on end. However, with the new Jetstar lounge it seems that the experience is not as awful as usual. The fights departed on time and even arrived slightly early. The pay as you go food options take the joy out of travel, and the starter plus allowance is inadequate for a MEL to NRT flight. But the food was edible. Paying the extra entertainment fee of $15 is extortionate, but luckily I like to read. The seats are cripplingly cramped and I’m hoping one day the airlines will be sued for contributing to the DVT death toll. On the whole though I would say that Jetstar has improved. Which isn’t really saying much given it started from such a low base.
reviews.author: Jane B

reviews.title: Basic Fast flight
reviews.text: As to be expected from a last minute “cheap” flight it was very basic in very nature of the word. Nothing to rave about as no international flight usually is anything exciting. The “paid” in flight entertainment was a tad dissapoting for a 9 hour flight and the fact they ran out of salads on such a flight was also a bit of a questionable moment from such a large and well known airline. I did expect better from Jetstar, as I have in previous experiences been much more pleased with the service as a whole!
reviews.author: Iszak

reviews.title: Best Budget Option
reviews.text: For short trips, Jetstar should be your Go-To airline. Crew was very helpful and smiles all the time. Food is better than expected and not much turbulence was felt during our flight.
reviews.author: JB Zarcal

reviews.title: Bed bugs and very poor service
reviews.text: We flew last Jan 8 with my mom and mya 2 kids (5 years old and 2 years old). First in the check in counter, the crews were not friendly. Plus considering my mom is senior citizen already and my kids are minors, there is no lane special lane. Unlike other airlines, they give consideration for that. Secondly, my mom and my kids was bitten by bed bugs during our flight. My daughter and has on their legs and my mother has on her back. It was really big, swollen and itchy. Though the seats/legroom is good but they should clean, disinfect and should have a overall check on the seats. Thirdly, our flight going back home was cancelled due the airport in Manila. Its unforeseable event so its acceptable but the earliest rebooking they can give is after 4 days. They should do something about it like prioritize the customers whom flight was cancelled since they will not provide any hotel or food for that. So we opt for refund and just booked other airline just to go homw because I have 2 kids and a senior with me and its difficult to be stranded especially if 1 of your kid is still on formula milk. This will be our first and last to ride this plane. Never ever again!
reviews.author: GCSantos

reviews.title: Solid budget option, pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: I was nervous about taking this flight based on some reviews but everything went off great. Left on time, check in was relatively smooth, and bags arrived without any issues. The flight attendants were nice and the plane was clean. Seats are what you expect for a budget airline, but overall a good experience. Wanted to chime in with my positive experience in case it helps ease worries for others.
reviews.author: MMKuroda

reviews.title: Spent more than an hr to check-in
reviews.text: Only opened 2 counters for 2 flights (one for Gold Coast, another for HK), 4 other staffs walking around / sitting at the counter doing nothing. Longest wait ever encountered.
reviews.author: CandyNg1987

reviews.title: Bribery jetstar japan
reviews.text: Terrible!! I was bribed of my money. They forced me to purchase an extra luggage worth 5300jpy. Because of my carry on luggage. Carry on supposed to be 35kg for 5 people. And my carry on just 32kg. But then the plastic bag and handbag they count and just add together by themselves It doesnt even reach 35kg. But they charge 5300jpy so i could put in to the luggage because they say cannot bring to plane . But in the end they asked me to pay. But after i paid they asked me to handcarry it. Bribery!!! Totally not recommended!! And they threatened me i couldnt get on the plane if i didnt pay.
reviews.author: Savac61

reviews.title: It will be worst flight experience in your life!
reviews.text: This is the first time I flew Jetstar and I will never fly it again. I knew this is a budget airline, so I never had any high expectation on it. However, Jetstar turned out to be the worst budget airline I have ever flown and I will tell you why! 1. They have you retrieve up your luggage between connection flights and super expensive cost for checked baggage! We had a domestic flight from Sapporo to Tokyo and followed by an international flight from Tokyo to Hong Kong. The ground staff at Sapporo check-in counter did not speak a word of English, she spent quite some time to explain to us that we had to get our luggage and recheck-in through their international counter in Tokyo, at first we thought we heard her wrong. Also, they charged us 10,000 yen for 2 luggage, both under 20kg, and measured the dimension of our only carry-on again and again. 2. All the flights delay! Our domestic flight was late by 30 minutes, however the layover time for our flight package was only 1hr50min. So by the time we arrived at Tokyo and got our bags, it was already less than an hour before the flight takeoff to Hong Kong. We had to run all the way to redo the check-in process and ran down to the gate, just to found out later our flight to Hong Kong was also delayed. 3. Boarding takes forever! The boarding is always a disaster for them. They have all passengers lineup to board at once and could take almost an hour to finish the process, no wonder their fight is always delayed. 4. Staffs were unresponsive and rude! The worst part of all is the service of their staffs on board! Due to their delayed flight, we couldn’t have a chance to have a bite to eat before on board, so we wanted to order food off the menu on the plane. I tired to call the air attendants 3 times that we wanted to order, they kept telling me to wait. My husband said they may only take order with their food trolley that they push down the aisle from front to end of the cabin. It doesn’t make sense, we were starving! But alright, I told myself I would play by the rule and wait, how unfortunate we sat at the end of the cabin. So we waited for another hour for the food trolley to come and the attendant pushed it right passed us, without stopping and back behind the curtain!!!!! I was like, didn’t I keep telling them we wanted to order?! It was so rude to ignore your customers like that! We called one of the attendant back and she goes, “Sorry, our food is sold out,” Could anyone tell me what did I miss here? The most dreadful thing is, we found out later that they lied about the food was sold out by seeing them stacked the rest of food boxes into the hot box for next trip. If you want cheap flight, I can tell you this airline isn’t exactly cheap with their high checked baggage cost and extra carry-on cost. The staffs’ inexperience and unhelpful service could also cost your vacation mood. I often travel to Japan and I never had this problem there before. Japanese are always well-known of their efficiency and hospitality. This airline is truly against the real Japanese culture and they should be shameful about that. I am sincerely sorry to have to find out something like that myself...
reviews.author: ellec866

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: All good for this flight. Checkin opened early and was efficient and also easy with our oversized snowboard bags. Flight left right on time and flight time was 45mins shorter than the advertised time which was an absolute bonus. Purchased onboard meal was good for the price and enjoyed the inflight entertainment. For the price, this flight was good value. Spoilt a little by the very long wait to collect baggage at Gold Coast airport, not sure if that's a Jetstar issue or Airport issue but wasn't a good look for international tourists visiting Australia...but it was very early xmas day.
reviews.author: Greg Harper

reviews.title: Short trip, good experience
reviews.text: A 3 hour flight. Short but comfortable. Had to bring my own pillos but the space between seats was okay.
reviews.author: Laura M

reviews.title: #1 Worst Airline Award for 2019
reviews.text: Jetstar rescheduled my flight with only 1 day notice and I had to make hotel arrangements to stay another night in Singapore, reschedule my connecting flight the next day which cost me $400 for me and my family, I lost a full days pay, and I had to extend my medical coverage for my entire family overseas. When asked if I would be compensated, they said no. On the day of the rescheduled flight (the next morning), I had a connecting flight that was 2.5 hours after my scheduled landing in Hong Kong (the one I rescheduled for $400 additional dollars). After boarding the plane in Singapore, Jetstar's staff realized there wasn't enough room for all the carry-on baggage on board. They started taking everyone's luggage off the plane and checking it in. But they FORGOT to tag the bags and FORGOT which customers they took the bags from. They had to unload ALL the bags from the plane and bring the bags back on board 1 by 1 asking who's bag it was on the speaker in the front of the plane. Then they issued tags 1 by 1. After going through 37 bags and sitting on the plane for 2.5 hours, they finally left. My flight landed just as my connecting flight was taking off so the $400 I spent on changing the flight to the next day was gone. Jetstar refused to take responsibility or do any type of reimbursement because it was under 3 hours. I was stuck in Hong Kong and they never picked up their customer service number. I called 4 different numbers and waited on hold for more than 30 min each time before giving up. I was in the airport for more than 7 hours trying to work something out. I was forced to book a hotel again and new flight tickets for 3 people on another airline to get home. They had no counter in the airport so I could not talk to anyone. After I got home, they said they would not pay even if it was their mistake. They pointed me to their Terms and Conditions where it says that they are not responsible for anything when you buy a ticket. There was no exception, no budging, and they didn't care at all. They just blew me off over the phone. All together, because of their mistakes, I ended up forking out an additional $2000 in insurance, new flight tickets, 2 stays in hotels, and 2 days of missed pay. I will NEVER fly with Jetstar again in my life. If there is a connecting flight that connects to Jetstar, I will look for any possible alternative. This is the worst airline in the world to fly. They don't care about their customers at all. Avoid them at all costs.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: What a joke....
reviews.text: Jetstar cheating and misleading their Business Class customers.... If you fly from Australia in the so called Jetstar Business Class which is really the equivalent Premium Economy Class on a regular airline once you connect in Japan onto Jetstar Japan (Domestic) you can forget your BC privileges. You are basically flying in Economy and they treat you as such an your luggage allowance is the economy allowance but you actually paid for a BC ticket all the way from Australia to Sapporo. Disgraceful!!! The airport and Gate facilities in Narita are another disgrace. New Chitose Airport is better as it is a newer airport but also not really up to par and very inconvenient with steps up and down and smooth flow of traffic..... Oh by the way don't even expect a glass of water on a 1.2hr flight... I wander why they even bother to have Flight Attendants on this flight....
reviews.author: Richard T

reviews.title: Efficient budget airline
reviews.text: From check in to boarding, the experience was quite nice considering were flying economy;flight schedule was on time and staff was very nice, the only thing thatbi dislike is they dont have that much selections of food and beverages
reviews.author: Adrian R

reviews.title: Easy direct and cheap!
reviews.text: If this is your first time taking the Narita express from Tokyo, be mindful that when the train stops at Narita, you are not at the airport yet. Cross the tracks and take another train to the terminals. Always be aware that the stop for International flights Terminal 3, is together with the stop for terminal 2 - I missed it and had to take a shuttle bus back as the train back is operated by a different company and you cannot use the same ticket! Both Jetstar flights were great, awesome crew and I think it is the first time I can say that I had a half decent airline meal. Meal and 20kg luggage was included in my ticket at great value. Thank you Jetstar, I will definitely use you again for this leg. Although it is an early morning flight it is a direct flight.
reviews.author: andremartin101
